title: Level 1 (Beginner) - A-7
notes:
South has 3 tricks in each of hearts, diamonds, and clubs. 4 tricks are required from spades. If the spades break 2-2 or 3-1, the ♠J will fall after the ♠A, ♠K, and ♠Q are played, making the ♠10 high. West's heart opening lead is won in dummy.

The only danger is when one of the defenders has 4 spades. When West has 4 spades, it is necessary not to play the ♠A on the first round of the suit. The first spade honour to be cashed must be the ♠K or ♠Q. East will discard and the ♠10 can now be led through West. Whether or not West covers, South will always have 4 tricks.

This plan also works when East is the one with 4 spades. After West shows out when the ♠K or ♠Q is played by South, the ♠A is cashed next. A finessing position remains over East's ♠J.
